match.introduce: DexLaunch is a multi-chain token launchpad supporting bonding curves, presales, and direct V3/V4 pool launches, with protocol revenue across chains distributed to DXL holders.
match.name: DexLaunch

match.introduce: OpenLaunch is an open-source zero platform fee token launchpad on Base and Robinhood Chain. Users create a fixed-supply token, Uniswap v4 pool, and permanently locked liquidity position in one transaction. The platform takes no fees, only gas is paid. Creators can set 0%, 1% or 3% trading fees to named recipients or burn them.
match.name: OpenLaunch

match.introduce: MerryForge is a fair-launch token marketplace on Robinhood Chain where creators issue fixed-supply community tokens, trade via transparent bonding curves, and graduate into locked AMM liquidity pools upon reaching raise caps.
match.name: MerryForge

match.introduce: Delpho is Hyperliquid’s productive dollar layer, transforming crypto collateral into liquidity that preserves directionality and earns real yield.
match.name: Delpho

match.introduce: Textile FX is an on-chain FX rail for stablecoins. Users request a firm quote for a pair and size; independent makers price it, and the swap settles atomically in one non-custodial transaction. Live corridors include local-currency and asset-backed stablecoins against USD stables on Celo, BNB Chain, Ethereum and others.
match.name: Textile FX

match.introduce: StockRip is a blockchain-based randomized acquisition protocol focused on tokenized stocks (e.g., Apple, Tesla). It allows users to bundle tokenized shares (including fractional shares) into a basket and deposit ETH as backing. This backing determines the basket's selection weight in the pool and forms an irrevocable standing bid to reacquire the basket. Any participant can pay the pool-derived acquisition price to randomly receive a stock position from the basket. Its core mechanism uses a pre-committed hash chain to ensure randomness is transparent and tamper-proof, offering a fair, non-traditional liquidity method for tokenized stocks.
match.one_liner: On-chain randomized tokenized stock acquisition protocol
match.name: StockRip

match.introduce: Pi Network is a mobile-based blockchain network designed to lower the barrier to cryptocurrency participation, enabling ordinary users to mine and build the ecosystem using their phones. It employs a variant of the Stellar Consensus Protocol (SCP), where users simply tap once daily to confirm identity and earn mining rewards without significant electricity or specialized hardware. Its core mechanism leverages a social trust graph to maintain network consensus, aiming to create a low-barrier digital currency ecosystem maintained by its users.
match.name: Pi Network

match.introduce: Crypto.com is a comprehensive cryptocurrency platform offering trading, payment, wallet, and decentralized finance (DeFi) services. It enables users to buy, sell, and hold various cryptocurrencies via mobile app or web interface, and spend crypto assets through Visa cards for everyday purchases. The platform includes a centralized exchange, a self-custody wallet, and Web3 applications built on the Cronos blockchain, allowing users to move assets between modules and participate in staking, lending, and liquidity farming. Its core mechanisms include fiat on/off ramps, an order-book matching engine, and on-chain settlement, designed to bridge traditional finance and the crypto ecosystem.
match.one_liner: One-stop crypto trading and payment platform
match.name: Crypto.com

match.introduce: RaiseHood is a fixed-price raise pad on Robinhood Chain where projects sell tokens at a set price in ETH, USDG, or Robinhood stock tokens, with liquidity permanently locked for 69 years once the soft cap is met.
match.name: RaiseHood

match.introduce: Unihood is a token launch platform based on Uniswap V4 on Robinhood Chain. It builds an automatically thickened price floor through a 1% transaction fee (80% goes to the creator, 5% is injected into the "buy wall" as a real buy order below the price, and 15% goes to the platform). The token is marked "graduated" when the market value is $60,000, but the trading mechanism remains unchanged.
match.name: Unihood

match.introduce: Enhanced is a decentralized structured yield layer that uses derivatives strategies to help users generate returns from onchain assets. It connects users with institutional market makers via an RFQ auction mechanism: users deposit assets (e.g., PAXG), market makers bid to purchase options, and users receive premiums upfront. Products include vaults and manual trading—vaults automate covered call strategies with compound or income modes; manual mode allows users to customize strike price, tenor, and other parameters. All transactions are signed and settled onchain.
match.name: Enhanced

match.introduce: MasterCard is an American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York. It offers a range of payment transaction processing and other related-payment services (such as travel-related payments and bookings).
match.name: Mastercard

match.introduce: Tempo is a high-performance Layer1 blockchain designed for payment, developed by Stripe and Paradigm. With support for all major stablecoins, Tempo enables high-throughput, low-cost global transactions for any business use case.
match.name: Tempo

match.introduce: Syntetika is an on-chain protocol that tokenizes institutional-grade investment strategies, offering a cbBTC vault. Users deposit cbBTC and receive hBTC, an ERC-4626 token representing a share, with NAV attested by an independent administrator and yield accruing automatically within the token. The strategy is managed by Hilbert Capital, employing market-neutral approaches (e.g., perpetual futures basis trading), with assets held by independent custodians and audited for transparency. Users enter by depositing cbBTC and redeem at NAV, subject to a subscription and redemption cycle.
match.name: Syntetika

match.introduce: What The Hook is a Uniswap v4 swap rebate hook that captures cross-pool arbitrage when prices diverge between connected pools and redistributes realized profit as trader rebates and LP rewards inside the same transaction. Third-party tokens can attach the hook at pool creation to keep that value on-chain for participants.
match.one_liner: Uniswap v4 hook that rebates arbitrage to traders and LPs
match.name: What The Hook

match.introduce: Bonker is a multi-chain token Launchpad that lets users deploy an ERC-20 token, create a Uniswap v4 pool, permanently lock liquidity, and configure creator rewards — all in a single transaction, via a message or web app.
match.name: Bonker

match.introduce: Spiral Stake is a non-custodial leveraged looping protocol designed exclusively for maximizing stablecoin yields. Building on Pendle’s PT infrastructure, Spiral Stake optimizes borrowing costs across Morpho lending pools to enable stable, predictable leveraged yields that function like high-yield bonds with DeFi upside potential.
match.name: Spiral Stake

match.introduce: FairLaunch is a fair launch platform specifically designed for cryptocurrency token launches, dedicated to eliminating bots, insiders, and whale advantages, giving everyone an equal opportunity to participate in token launches.
match.name: Fairlaunch

match.introduce: With a commitment to ensuring strong and lasting support for blockchain innovation, the Algorand Foundation fosters an open and transparent system where anyone can participate, develop, and innovate on the permissionless Algorand protocol, guided by the vision of an inclusive economy.
match.one_liner: Building trusted infrastructure for the borderless economy
match.name: Algorand Foundation

match.introduce: Vetro is a funding layer for USD-denominated digital assets.
match.one_liner: The treasury layer for dollar-denominated digital assets
match.name: Vetro

match.introduce: Coinbarrel is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain that enables atomic token launches in a single transaction via Uniswap V4 Hook V5, with permanently locked liquidity for every token.
match.name: Coinbarrel

match.introduce: IGNIX is a universal token launch platform deployed on X Layer. Through the Bonding Curve and customizable treasury mechanism, creators can customize the transaction tax distribution method and support the integration of AI agents.
match.name: IGNIX

match.introduce: Fables is a non-custodial tokenized US stock market-making protocol built on Uniswap v4 Hook framework, deployed on Robinhood Chain. Users deposit assets, select price ranges, and earn trading fees through dynamic fees calculated in real-time by Hook contracts, which also record market-making shares. Its fee mechanism is determined by three models—calendar, fixed benchmark, and directional—to mitigate risks from mismatches between 24/7 on-chain trading and US stock market hours. The protocol adopts a ve(3,3) governance mechanism, with PROLOGUE as a pre-governance token redeemable for the governance token FABLES.
match.one_liner: Tokenized US stock market-making protocol on Uniswap v4
match.name: Fables

match.introduce: Umia is a full-stack operating platform for token-native ventures, integrating project launch, community fundraising, and on-chain governance. It provides infrastructure for legal entity formation, token issuance, and treasury management, and pioneers a "decision market" mechanism: key proposals are turned into prediction markets where participants express views by trading conditional tokens on different outcomes. The market settles via time-weighted average price (TWAP) and automatically executes the winning outcome. This mechanism aims to replace traditional voting with market signals, enhancing governance efficiency and treasury transparency.
match.one_liner: Full-stack operating platform for token-native ventures
match.name: Umia

match.introduce: Stonx is a launchpad on Base enabling users to create and trade memecoins paired with tokenized equities such as NVDA and TSLA. Tokens feature a fixed 1B supply, permanently locked liquidity, and trading fees split with creators. Built on Doppler and Uniswap v4, the platform is non-custodial and independent.
match.one_liner: Launchpad for memecoins paired with tokenized stocks
match.name: Stonx

match.introduce: PerpMe is a token launchpad on HyperEVM. Every launch mints its full supply into a single-sided Uniswap V3 position on PRJX and sends the LP NFT to the PerpMe locker, which has no function to decrease liquidity or move the position — so the liquidity is locked permanently. Trading fees from each pool are split 60/40 between the coin's creator and the platform.
match.name: PerpMe

match.introduce: Soil is a blockchain-based lending protocol that bridges traditional finance and the crypto world. It allocates stablecoins (e.g., USDC) deposited by investors into fully collateralized SME loans through on-chain vaults, generating fixed returns. The protocol offers Liquid Vaults (flexible access) and Credit Vaults (fixed-term lockup), and supports XRP-denominated yield. Loans are selected by a professional team and backed by legal safeguards and risk controls.
match.one_liner: An on-chain lending protocol connecting the real economy
match.name: Soil

match.introduce: token.select is a fair-launch token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.
match.name: token.select

match.introduce: Astro is a no-code DAO launch platform for launching decentralized autonomous organizations on Near. It empowers groups from all over the world to make decisions together, collectively.
match.name: Astro

match.introduce: tx is an operating system for real-world asset tokenization, combining technology, compliance and liquidity. It offers a purpose-built Layer-1, smart-token compliance controls, a self-custody super app and RWA marketplace infrastructure connecting issuers, regulated entities and investors for issuance, lifecycle management and trading of tokenized assets.
match.one_liner: Operating system for real-world asset tokenization
match.name: tx

match.introduce: Bisonfi is a PropAMM launched by SOL treasury company Forward Industries.
match.name: Bisonfi

match.introduce: Menese Protocol is a multichain execution layer on the Internet Computer. Using chain-key cryptography, canisters build and sign transactions for sovereign wallets, cross-chain swaps, liquidity routing and automation across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and 20+ other chains, without custodial bridges.
match.one_liner: ICP multichain sovereign wallet and execution layer
match.name: Menese Protocol

match.introduce: Morpheus is a decentralized AI inference marketplace that coordinates AI model providers and consumers via blockchain smart contracts. It allows users to access AI inference through an API or a local node, without relying on centralized services. Its mechanism includes: providers register models, consumers pay per session duration, and funds are escrowed and settled on-chain.
match.name: Morpheus

match.introduce: MassPay is a global financial orchestration platform enabling businesses to collect and send payments to recipients in more than 180 countries across multiple rails, currencies, and payout methods, including local bank transfers, mobile wallets, real-time payments, and stablecoins.
match.name: MassPay

match.introduce: Pangolin is a decentralized exchange protocol on the Avalanche blockchain. It employs an automated market maker model to enable token swaps. Users connect a compatible wallet to select trading pairs for swaps or supply assets to liquidity pools to earn a share of trading fees. Documentation outlines core mechanisms including constant product formula pricing and liquidity management processes.
match.name: Pangolin

match.introduce: Bitwise is an asset management firm focused exclusively on the cryptocurrency space, dedicated to providing compliant and transparent digital asset investment solutions for institutional and individual investors. Its business spans index funds, active management strategies, and model portfolios, offered through formats such as ETFs, private funds, and trusts. Bitwise is known for rigorous research and risk management, helping investors efficiently allocate to major crypto assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum while managing associated risks.
match.one_liner: A compliant investment manager focused on crypto assets
match.name: Bitwise

match.introduce: DogeOS is an application layer for the Dogecoin ecosystem, created by the team behind the MyDoge wallet, aiming to bring smart contracts and decentralized applications to Dogecoin. It leverages zero-knowledge proof technology (such as the proposed OP_CHECKZKP opcode) to build a zk-rollup, where batches of transactions are compressed into a single proof verified on the Dogecoin mainnet, enhancing scalability without altering Dogecoin's core. Developers can use Ethereum tools like Solidity, while end users connect via compatible wallets.
match.one_liner: Dogecoin's app layer: a ZK-proof-based smart contract platform
match.name: DogeOS

match.introduce: SharpByte Capital is a crypto-native investment fund founded by Marco Manoppo, focused on capturing asymmetric opportunities arising from the combination of on-chain yield and off-chain industry resources. The fund is centered on yield strategies, covering areas such as DeFi and RWA tokenization, while also providing strategic advisory and liquidity management services to early-stage protocols. The founder previously worked at Primitive Ventures and Digital Asset Research, bringing institutional research and investment experience.
match.one_liner: A crypto-native fund focused on yield
match.name: SharpByte Capital

match.introduce: Hookers is the incubator for hooked markets.
match.name: Hookers

match.introduce: OpenStock is an on-chain pre-IPO investment platform that allows users to deposit USDC to receive vault tokens representing IPO allocation claims, which can be redeemed for USDC at net value after the company lists.
match.name: OpenStock

match.introduce: Keyrock is a market maker and quantitative trading firm focused on digital assets, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. It leverages proprietary self-adaptive algorithms and high-frequency trading technology to provide liquidity and market-making services for cryptocurrency exchanges, token projects, and institutional clients. Its core activities include providing two-sided quotes on centralized and decentralized exchanges to tighten bid-ask spreads, managing inventory risk through quantitative strategies, and designing liquidity solutions for newly issued tokens. Clients can access customized liquidity support via its API or partnership frameworks.
match.one_liner: Digital asset market maker and quantitative trading firm
match.name: Keyrock

match.introduce: Flowdesk is a digital asset trading and liquidity provider specializing in institutional OTC trading, market making, and token liquidity solutions. It connects centralized and decentralized exchanges through proprietary trading technology, offering deep liquidity, algorithmic execution, and risk management tools. Clients can access block trading, token issuance support, and customized market-making services. Flowdesk is regulated by the French AMF and registered with Dubai's VARA, serving global institutional clients in a compliant manner.
match.one_liner: Institutional-grade digital asset market making and OTC trading platform
match.name: Flowdesk

match.introduce: Architect is an institutional-grade digital asset trading technology company that provides high-performance, customizable trading infrastructure for professional trading teams. Its core product is an API-first trading platform supporting multiple asset classes including spot and derivatives, integrating tools such as smart order routing, algorithmic execution, risk management, and real-time monitoring. Institutions can seamlessly connect the platform to their own trading systems via open APIs and WebSocket interfaces to automate strategies like market making and arbitrage. Architect emphasizes low latency, high throughput, and modular design, enabling traders to flexibly build and execute complex trading workflows.
match.one_liner: Institutional-grade digital asset trading technology platform
match.name: Architect

match.introduce: Binance is one of the world's largest digital asset exchanges, aiming to be the infrastructure services provider for the blockchain ecosystem. It features a portfolio of crypto products and offerings, such as trading and finance, education, data and research, social good, investment and incubation, decentralization and infrastructure solutions, and more.
match.one_liner: The world's largest digital asset exchange
match.name: Binance

match.introduce: Archade is a short-video social platform on the Solana blockchain, with built-in DEX and token launch functionality.
match.name: Archade

match.introduce: TermiX is an AI-driven Web3 operating system that enables AI agents to autonomously publish, execute, verify, and settle on-chain tasks through the AACP standard protocol framework. Its core mechanisms include: the SES secure execution environment, combining TEE and zkVM technologies to ensure agents run in isolated and verifiable environments; the ERC-8183 asset layer, which locks task funds in escrow contracts to ensure transaction security; and the ERC-8004 reputation layer, which implements decentralized arbitration through on-chain reputation records.
match.name: TermiX

match.introduce: Hertzflow is a perpetual contract decentralized exchange (DEX) built on BNB Chain, utilizing a Request-for-Quote (RFQ) model where traders execute directly against market makers/liquidity pools rather than a traditional order book. It supports perpetual trading on cryptocurrencies, forex, commodities, and other assets, offering leverage up to 500x. Its core mechanisms include: multi-oracle price feeds (primarily Pyth, with CEX indices as fallback) to ensure price reliability; and a modular smart contract architecture (e.g., ExchangeRouter, OrderHandler) that separates responsibilities for easier upgrades and security audits.
match.one_liner: A RFQ-based perpetual DEX on BNB Chain
match.name: Hertzflow

match.introduce: Presto is an algorithmic trading and digital asset financial services firm, specializing in market making, over-the-counter (OTC) trading, and liquidity provision. It leverages proprietary trading systems and quantitative models to execute high-frequency strategies across centralized and decentralized markets, offering tailored execution solutions for institutional clients.
match.one_liner: Algorithmic trading and digital asset liquidity provider
match.name: Presto

match.introduce: Aster is a decentralized derivatives exchange built on its own Aster Chain, supporting multi-chain asset trading. It offers perpetual contracts, spot trading, and a 1001x leverage mode that simplifies execution by trading directly against on-chain liquidity. It also provides privacy protection through zero-knowledge proofs, encrypting orders and concealing trader identities and positions. Aster integrates grid trading, yield products such as liquid staking and interest-bearing stablecoins, as well as pre-listing contracts and equity perpetuals.
match.one_liner: Aster is a decentralized perp DEX
match.name: Aster

match.introduce: GoonFi is an AMM trading protocol based on Solana.
match.name: GoonFi

match.introduce: Tessera V is a Solana-based PropAMM operated by Wintermute.
match.name: Tessera V

match.introduce: SoFi(Nasdaq: SOFI) is a one-stop digital financial platform that provides comprehensive financial services to individuals and businesses, including student and personal loans, home loans and refinancing, credit cards, bank accounts, investments, insurance, and a B2B fintech platform.
match.name: SoFi

match.introduce: LEVR is decentralized leveraged sports betting that transforms this landscape by enabling up to 5x leverage on bets, unlocking new possibilities for bettors.
match.name: LEVR.bet

match.introduce: JPEG Trading is a quantitative and proprietary trading firm specializing in cryptocurrency and decentralized finance (DeFi) markets. Its core operations include high-frequency and mid-frequency trading, liquidity provision, and an emerging asset curation service. For curation, JPEG Trading combines deep technical analysis with financial due diligence to actively evaluate and select promising on-chain assets, deploying its own capital to back these assessments and facilitate the adoption of high-quality collateral within DeFi protocols. Its first curated asset is a tokenized gold product.
match.one_liner: A quantitative trading and asset curation firm focused on crypto and DeFi
match.name: JPEG Trading

match.introduce: zERC20 is a cross-chain private ERC-20 protocol that enables private transfers using the same operations as regular ERC-20 tokens. It works directly from wallets like MetaMask. Users wrap assets such as USDC, ETH, BNB and JPYC 1:1 into zUSDC, zETH and similar z-tokens, send them to a burn address with no private key, and recipients redeem equivalent amounts to any unlinked address via zero-knowledge proofs. The mechanism is based on EIP-7503 zkWormhole, making private transfers indistinguishable from ordinary ones on-chain.
match.name: zERC20

match.introduce: DGrid is a decentralized AI inference network that connects model providers and users through a standardized RPC interface, with blockchain-based settlement and verification. It offers a unified API to access various LLMs and Agents, supports intelligent routing, pay-per-use via the x402 protocol, on-chain settlement, and result verification based on Proof of Quality. Developers can simply point their OpenAI SDK base_url to the DGrid gateway to use compatible endpoints, while model providers can deploy nodes to perform inference and earn rewards. Its mechanisms include distributed node execution, real-time performance reporting, decentralized governance (AI DAO), and tamper-proof on-chain audit records, aiming to reduce AI integration costs and increase transparency.
match.one_liner: Decentralized AI inference and settlement network
match.name: DGrid

match.introduce: DAMM Capital, a company focused on decentralized capital management solutions, develops customized solutions for users to address their DeFi needs.
match.name: DAMM Capital

match.introduce: Dune is a blockchain data analytics platform that allows users to query, analyze, and visualize public blockchain data using SQL. It decodes and indexes raw on-chain data into structured tables covering transactions, token transfers, DEX trades, and more. Users can write queries in a web editor, create charts and dashboards, and share them publicly. All queries are public by default, enabling forking and modification of others' queries for further analysis. The platform supports EVM-compatible chains and non-EVM chains like Solana. Its technical architecture includes the DuneSQL query engine and distributed execution to handle large-scale datasets.
match.name: Dune

match.introduce: EARN is a liquidity protocol for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Holders deposit into automated vaults or Omnipools. A vault markets a single stock pair. An Omnipool holds up to eight tokens in one shared market so LPs keep basket exposure and earn fees from every swap in the pool. Swap fee is 0.30%, with 90% to LPs and 10% to the protocol. The app also has looped LP positions, Longbow credit markets, and an agent skill file. Protocol fees buy $EARN for stakers.
match.name: EARN

match.introduce: Doma Protocol is a decentralized domain protocol that tokenizes traditional DNS domains, enabling them to be traded, borrowed against, and integrated into Web3 applications on the blockchain. It separates domain ownership from management through two token types: an Ownership Token (DOT) representing the domain asset itself, and a Service Token (DST) controlling management functions like DNS records. Its technical core is cross-chain messaging, supporting the transfer of domain assets between different blockchains such as Ethereum and Solana, while maintaining compatibility with the existing internet DNS system.
match.one_liner: A protocol tokenizing traditional domains for cross-chain trading
match.name: Doma Protocol

match.introduce: Mt Pelerin is a Swiss-based crypto fintech company offering non-custodial (self-custodial) digital asset services. Its core product is Bridge Wallet, a mobile app that lets users manage their private keys directly and buy, sell, or exchange multiple cryptocurrencies with fiat, supporting assets on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and various EVM-compatible chains. The platform provides personal IBANs, enabling users to deposit or withdraw fiat via bank transfer, and can automatically convert salaries into crypto. The company operates Bridge Protocol, an open-source multi-chain tokenization platform for issuing and managing compliant security tokens, with on-chain KYC/AML rule enforcement.
match.one_liner: Swiss non-custodial crypto wallet and tokenization platform
match.name: Mt Pelerin

match.introduce: Longbow is a decentralized credit layer protocol built on Robinhood Chain, focusing on lending markets. It allows users to deposit USDG to provide liquidity and earn interest, or borrow USDG using various assets as collateral, including tokenized stocks, crypto assets, RWAs, and memecoins. The protocol adopts an isolated market design, where each market independently sets oracles, liquidation parameters, and supply caps to isolate risk. The settlement layer is based on Morpho Blue, with pricing via Chainlink oracles and Uniswap TWAP. The protocol token BOW is used for governance and capturing protocol fees, supporting staking, buybacks, and other mechanisms. All contracts are verified on Blockscout for transparency.
match.one_liner: Credit layer lending protocol on Robinhood Chain
match.name: Longbow

match.introduce: NUKES.FUN is a crypto-native information aggregation and trading tool platform focused on the prediction market Polymarket. Its core function is to aggregate global event feeds, identify high-volatility sectors (such as geopolitics), and provide market intelligence to users. The platform presents a real-time information feed through a clean interface, helping users capture market opportunities.
match.one_liner: Crypto info aggregator focused on Polymarket
match.name: NUKES.FUN

match.introduce: PEZ.family is a zero-platform-fee token launchpad on Robinhood Chain that uses a bonding curve mechanism, graduating tokens to permanently locked Uniswap V4 pools once sold out, with creators retaining 100% of trade fees.
match.name: PEZ.family

match.introduce: TwoFold is a DeFi liquidity protocol built on Uniswap v4 and Robinhood Chain. By deploying an unmodified Uniswap v4 hook, it automatically deposits idle USDG assets from pools into Steakhouse's Morpho Vaults V2 to earn lending yield, while simultaneously utilizing those funds to provide liquidity during swaps to earn trading fees, achieving dual yield on the same capital. The protocol supports trading pairs such as WETH, TWO, and tokenized equities like SPY, QQQ, NVDA. The protocol also features governance voting and a permanent liquidity lock mechanism.
match.one_liner: A dual-yield DeFi liquidity protocol on Uniswap v4
match.name: TwoFold

match.introduce: NEAR Protocol is a sharded decentralized computing platform designed to provide a blockchain environment with high throughput, low latency, and low fees. It supports smart contracts written in Rust and JavaScript/TypeScript, and simplifies user experience through account abstraction, such as human-readable account names. NEAR also offers chain abstraction capabilities for cross-chain interoperability and AI-related tools.
match.name: NEAR Protocol

match.introduce: Perps Hood is a launchpad where every coin is backed by a live leveraged perpetual owned by that coin's own on-chain sub-wallet. Trading fees fund the perp; profits buy back and burn supply; drawdowns only add margin. The position never closes and nothing unwinds at graduation.
match.name: Perpshood

match.introduce: Astar Fi is an onchain personal finance manager that lets users view onchain net worth and act via Save, Earn and Invest; it reads the portfolio without taking custody. Save displays net worth split between investment and money, allocation by category, protocol or network, plus concentration and liquidity. Earn shows vault current yield, 30-day average, risk tier and rating, with underlying allocation, collateral, risk details and contract address. Incubated by Astar Network.
match.name: Astar Fi

match.introduce: Qiro Finance is a decentralized private credit protocol designed to connect stablecoin investors with vetted asset originators. Its core mechanism is a distributed underwriting network, where independent nodes run data-driven credit models to evaluate borrowers and generate reports, addressing risk pricing and transparency issues in on-chain credit. The protocol employs a senior/junior tranche structure: investors can purchase senior tranches for yield, while underwriter nodes and asset originators are required to hold junior tranches as a risk buffer, aligning their interests with loan performance. Qiro provides on-chain financing channels for real-world assets (RWA) through standardized credit pools and on-chain data monitoring.
match.name: Qiro Finance

match.introduce: Dirac Finance is an institutional grade decentralized options vault.Earn yield through options, structured products, and principal-protected coupon notes strategies
match.name: Dirac Finance

match.introduce: Elara Finance is a treasury management protocol generating real yield through proprietary concentrated liquidity.
match.name: Elara Finance

match.introduce: TOLLY is a decentralized token launchpad and DEX built on the Arc network. It enables one-click fair token launches, with liquidity automatically added in USDC and permanently locked, eliminating migration and rug-pull risks. A 1% fee is charged on every trade, split as follows: 64% to the creator, 12% to token holders weighted by holding time, 10% to protocol operations, 9% to buy back and burn TOLLY, and 5% to buy back and burn the traded token itself. All fee distributions are hardcoded in the contract with no admin keys. trading other Arc tokens on the platform generates fees that are used to buy back and burn TOLLY, allowing TOLLY to capture value from the entire ecosystem's trading volume.
match.one_liner: A token launchpad and DEX on Arc
match.name: Tolly

match.introduce: Tsunami is a token launchpad based on Ink.
match.name: Tsunami

match.introduce: Humanity Protocol is a blockchain-based digital identity verification protocol, with its core mechanism being "Proof of Humanity." It aims to verify that a user is a unique real human in a privacy-preserving and low-cost manner, using biometrics such as palm recognition. It leverages zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) and decentralized identifiers (DIDs) to allow users to prove their identity or specific attributes (e.g., age, residency) to applications without revealing personal sensitive data. Developers can integrate identity verification into their applications via its SDK and API for use cases like anti-Sybil in airdrops, community governance, and credential issuance.
match.name: Humanity Protocol

match.introduce: Lumerin is a decentralized hashrate routing protocol built on blockchain. It enables peer-to-peer trading and routing of hashpower via smart contracts. Users deploy nodes to connect miners or pools for buying, selling, allocating and settling hashpower. The protocol uses on-chain contracts to manage orders, payments and execution without centralized intermediaries.
match.name: Lumerin

match.introduce: The Interfold is a decentralized confidential computing protocol that combines Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), and Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to execute computations directly on encrypted data via a distributed network of Ciphernodes, without trusting any single centralized party. It supports sealed-bid auctions, private voting, and collaborative analysis of sensitive data: data providers encrypt inputs with a shared public key and publish commitments onchain; nodes are selected via sortition to form a Ciphernode Committee (CiCo), which generates keys, performs the computation, and produces verifiable proofs; the final result is decrypted only when a preset threshold is met, keeping data encrypted throughout.
match.name: The Interfold

match.introduce: Genius.fun is a token launchpad on BNB Chain where users create tokens and trade them on a bonding curve with BNB.
match.name: Genius.fun

match.introduce: Mog is a self-bootstrapping perpetual DEX offering up to 1,000x leverage on stocks, memes and more, with zero funding fees and zero slippage from order size. Trades face the protocol treasury at oracle prices with no order book or market makers; trading activity itself builds treasury liquidity for future payouts.
match.name: Mog

match.introduce: AntSeed is a decentralized peer-to-peer network for AI services, designed to eliminate intermediaries in AI calls. It enables providers to directly sell AI inference and agent services to buyers, who discover, route, and pay through a local proxy. It builds a decentralized directory on BEP 5 DHT, retrieves provider metadata via HTTP endpoints, and employs multi-factor scoring (price, latency, capacity, reputation, etc.) for intelligent routing, while also supporting peer pinning and Skills filtering.
match.name: AntSeed

match.introduce: Pare is a DeFi protocol on Robinhood Chain that splits tokenized stocks into separate price and dividend components. Users deposit a stock token (e.g., AAPL, SPY, QQQ) and receive equal amounts of Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT). PT represents price exposure without dividends and redeems at face value at maturity; YT captures the entire dividend stream until maturity. Both tokens are tradable on Uniswap v3, PT can be posted as collateral on Morpho for borrowing, and the two can be merged back into the original stock at any time for free. The protocol tracks dividends via the ERC-8056 multiplier, and fees are used to buy back and burn PARE tokens.
match.one_liner: Splits tokenized stocks into price and dividend components on-chain
match.name: Pare

match.introduce: Foci is a memecoin launchpad on Arc that lets users create tokens in one click. The platform lists trending, new and graduated tokens with filters by market cap and 24h volume, enabling discovery and trading of memecoins quoted in USDC.
match.name: Foci

match.introduce: DeTrade is a multi-asset trading platform designed to connect traditional finance with the on-chain economy. Through futures, binary options, spread options, CFDs, copy trading, demo trading and prediction markets, DeTrade provides eligible users with a tiered product experience across a range of trading scenarios.
match.name: Detrade

match.introduce: GT Protocol is a Web3 AI investment protocol that connects CeFi, DeFi, and NFT markets through a conversational AI interface. Core features include: AI trading agents that execute strategies automatically, supporting trading on platforms such as Binance and Hyperliquid; an AI strategy backtesting tool that lets users describe trading ideas in natural language and automatically generates and tests strategies; copy trading that replicates strategies from verified traders; and an MCP server that enables AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT to access trading functions directly. Usage: users connect exchanges via API keys or wallets through Magic, authorizing trades in a non-custodial manner, with funds always remaining under user control. The platform also offers demo trading for risk-free strategy testing.
match.name: GT Protocol

match.introduce: Spine Finance is a provable lending protocol on Ethereum and EVM-compatible blockchains specializing in facilitating fixed-interest-rate financial transactions through an efficient automated market maker mechanism called BondMM.Spine enable users to efficiently lend and borrow money at fixed interest rates by building on top of existing variable-rate lending protocols including Morpho, Aave, Venus, Compound, Euler, and more.
match.name: Spine Finance

match.introduce: Kaleidoswap is a decentralized trading platform that combines Bitcoin's security, Lightning Network's speed, and RGB Protocol programmability in a single open-source desktop application.
match.name: Kaleidoswap

match.introduce: Flipcash is a digital currency creation platform built on the Solana blockchain, enabling users to create their own community currencies. Its core mechanism is a reserve model: each currency is pegged to USDF (a stablecoin issued in partnership with Coinbase) through a fixed pricing curve, ensuring liquidity. Users can buy or sell currencies directly from the reserve with transparent, predictable prices. The platform supports instant swaps between currencies and emphasizes non-custodial features, giving users full control over their assets. This design aims to solve the common problems of low liquidity and high price volatility in traditional community tokens, allowing communities to build sustainable monetary systems.
match.name: Flipcash

match.introduce: DTCC is the premier post-trade market infrastructure for the global financial services industry. From 20 locations around the world, DTCC, through its subsidiaries, automates, centralizes, and standardizes the processing of financial transactions, mitigating risk, increasing transparency, enhancing performance and driving efficiency for thousands of broker/dealers, custodian banks and asset managers.
match.name: DTCC

match.introduce: zk.money is a self-custodial privacy wallet on Aztec Network, built by Aztec Labs. Users send and receive crypto via readable tags; balances, amounts and counterparties stay private by default. Funds deposit from Ethereum, move privately inside the network, and can withdraw back to Ethereum.
match.one_liner: Self-custodial private payments wallet on Aztec
match.name: zk.money

match.introduce: Orbio is an AI inference-credit marketplace on Robinhood Chain. Users call 400-plus models such as Claude Fable, GPT Astra, and Gemini through an OpenAI-compatible API. Requests go to the named model; prompts are not stored. Staking ORBIO earns CREDIT. One CREDIT equals one dollar of Orbio inference and can be held, transferred, traded on an on-chain order book, or activated, which burns it into an API balance. Agents can buy CREDIT without staking.
match.name: Orbio

match.introduce: Three Protocol is a blockchain-based decentralized marketplace protocol designed to replace traditional centralized employment and e-commerce platforms. It leverages zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP) to protect user privacy, manages transactions and disputes through a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) and Tri-Proof smart contracts, and uses an AI model to match supply and demand.
match.name: Three Protocol

match.introduce: United Founders Group (UFG) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 token on Robinhood Chain backed by an immutable ETH treasury. It is the first product of a broader onchain treasury platform, built on a deliberately simple model: creator fees flow into a transparent ETH treasury, and UFG holders can redeem their pro-rata share of ETH at any time, with a 2% exit fee that ensures the ETH backing per remaining token never declines. The platform plans to expand with additional experimental strategies, each in its own contract with clear disclosures, while UFG itself serves as the platform treasury, governed by fixed rules with no owner or upgrade path.
match.name: United Founders Group

match.introduce: Faze is a token launchpad on Arc Chain. Users launch tokens with custom bonding targets that graduate into locked Uniswap v4 liquidity pools with USDC fees. Launchers can adjust pool fees, transfer fee rights, enable liquidity compounding and token burns, and use two-step on-chain community takeovers. Faze Terminal provides one-tap buys, watchlists, KOL feeds and built-in wallet PNL analytics.
match.one_liner: Arc token launch and trading platform
match.name: Faze

match.introduce: BT.Finance is a multi-chain smart DeFi yield aggregator that targets the best and sustainable yield for tokens. The project is launched by the community and will be run by a DAO that is governed by votes from the community. The Vaults are divided into three pools: Stable Profits Pool, High Yield Pool, and Smart Hybrid Pool, to cater to users with various risk tolerances.
match.name: BT.Finance

match.introduce: Overlayer is a non-custodial smart-contract protocol that wraps stablecoins such as USDC and USDT into liquid, non-rebasing, composable overlaid assets (e.g., C+ and T+). Users mint overlaid assets at a deterministic 1:1 ratio by depositing supported stablecoins and can use them across DeFi. If yield is desired, users can stake the overlaid assets to receive a separate share-based representation whose value accrues via exchange-rate appreciation, with yield sourced from realized returns at external venues such as Aave. The protocol does not rely on leverage, forced lockups, or token emissions; core operations (mint, redeem, stake, unstake) are permissionless on-chain actions, and LayerZero enables cross-chain transfer.
match.one_liner: Upgrade stablecoins into yield-bearing non-custodial overlaid assets
match.name: Overlayer

match.introduce: Securitize is a real-world asset (RWA) tokenization platform providing a full suite of compliant infrastructure from issuance to trading. Asset managers can convert traditional assets such as fund shares into digital securities on blockchain, using smart contracts for automated compliance and dividend distribution. The platform supports multiple blockchains including Ethereum and Solana, and integrates SEC-registered broker-dealer, digital transfer agent, alternative trading system (ATS), and fund administration services, covering the complete lifecycle of token issuance, investor management, secondary trading, and fund administration. Investors can trade tokenized private equity, credit, and other assets on its regulated ATS.
match.name: Securitize

match.introduce: Zcash is a blockchain-based privacy cryptocurrency derived from the Bitcoin codebase, which protects transaction privacy through zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs). It supports transparent and shielded addresses: transparent transactions resemble Bitcoin and are publicly visible, while shielded transactions encrypt the sender, receiver, and amount, decryptable only by holders of viewing keys.
match.one_liner: Privacy cryptocurrency that hides transaction details with zero-knowledge proofs
match.name: Zcash

match.introduce: GenesisL1 is an EVM blockchain for desci applications and DAOs. GenesisL1 decentralize vital and open biological databases and datasets, machine learning models and weights (e.g. PDBbank, UniProt, Alphafold db, ProteinNet, IPD-IMGT/HLA, etc) with blockchain, writing data in blockchain and provide open source EVM dApps with environment for scientific research and education, for example NFT of molecular structures: MolNFT.ORG, or dataset constructor for machine learning tokenized with NFT and ProtCrud indexed with GenesisL1: DatasetNFT.org, or Web3 pairwise alignments implemented via smart contracts.
match.one_liner: EVM blockchain for desci applications and DAOs
match.name: GenesisL1

match.introduce: Papertrade is a synthetic perpetual contract protocol built on HyperEVM. Instead of relying on a traditional order book, it lets users trade directly against the protocol's liquidity pool (LP), using Hyperliquid's BBO mid price as the price source, achieving zero slippage, zero funding fees, and supporting high leverage. When opening a position, the user locks in that mid price as the entry price; when closing, profit and loss are settled at the latest mid price. The protocol does not charge users trading fees, but takes a percentage from profitable trades. When users lose or get liquidated, the loss goes into the LP, and the user receives PAPER tokens as compensation. PAPER tokens have no pre-mine and can be staked to share protocol revenue. This mechanism creates a counterparty relationship between the LP and users, sustained by token incentives.
match.name: Papertrade

match.introduce: tacit is bitcoin privacy protocol with shielded amounts, shielded addresses, anonymous spend via mixer pools, a native AMM, and trustless wrapped BTC — all settled on Bitcoin L1, privacy layered so each user picks the level that fits the use case.
match.name: tacit

match.introduce: BTR is a US-listed equity traded on American stock exchanges. The ticker does not clearly map to a widely recognized public company based on publicly available information. Further details should be obtained from official regulatory filings.
match.one_liner: BTR is a US-listed equity traded on American stock exchanges. The ticker does not clearly map to a widely recognized public company based on publicly available information. Further details should be obtained from official regulatory filings.
match.name: BTR

match.introduce: Numerai is a decentralized data science competition platform focused on stock market prediction. It provides encrypted and obfuscated financial data, which data scientists use to build machine learning models to predict future stock performance. After submitting predictions, users can stake the native token NMR to participate in reward distribution; good predictions earn NMR rewards, while poor predictions are burned. The platform integrates all submitted predictions through a meta-model to guide its hedge fund trading. Numerai Signals allows users to submit signals using their own data, which are neutralized and evaluated for uniqueness. The mechanism aims to incentivize genuinely effective predictions while preventing overfitting.
match.name: Numerai

match.introduce: Baibai is a prop AMM, a new type of decentralized exchange that quotes prices in real-time and dynamically adjusts liquidity depth. Unlike traditional amms, Baibai is designed to offer tighter spreads and better execution.
match.name: BaiBai

match.introduce: Arkade is an open-source execution engine built on Bitcoin. It processes transactions off-chain in a Virtual Mempool and inherits Bitcoin's security through batched on-chain settlement. Developers can use its SDK to build applications for payments, asset transfers, and smart contracts. Users submit transactions via an Operator, which executes them instantly off-chain and later anchors them to the Bitcoin network in batches. The mechanism relies on pre-signed Bitcoin transactions and operator cooperation, ensuring users retain control of their assets and can exit to the chain when necessary.
match.name: Arkade

match.introduce: Statics Protocol is a DeFi lending protocol built on the EIP-2535 diamond standard, with a core mechanism of "self-backed lending": users deposit BasketTokens as collateral to borrow the corresponding underlying asset portfolio. The protocol adopts a dual-diamond architecture, separating user interactions from the collateral and solvency state of the Statics Dollar, reducing systemic risk. Loans are backed by the value of the basket tokens themselves, without oracle dependency, and liquidation risk is governed by collateral ratio constraints. The protocol also integrates with Uniswap v4 for liquidity and includes a fee-sharing mechanism.
match.one_liner: Self-backed lending protocol on diamond standard
match.name: Statics Protocol

match.introduce: Nullmask is a zero-knowledge privacy protocol that installs as a virtual network in any existing multichain wallet—no new wallet or seed required. Users shield assets into a private pool, then make untraceable transfers, withdrawals and swaps; zk proofs are generated client-side and submitted via a relayer so deposit and withdrawal stay unlinkable onchain.
match.one_liner: ZK privacy protocol for any existing wallet
match.name: Nullmask

match.introduce: Payy is a zero-knowledge privacy layer on Ethereum for stablecoin payments, offering private transfers, hidden balances, and selective auditability. It manages private state via a UTXO model and sparse Merkle tree. Users can use Payy Wallet or SDK to generate zero-knowledge proofs and bridge assets from the public EVM layer to the privacy layer, enabling transfers that hide sender, receiver, and amount. Payy Links encode payment intent into URLs that can be shared through messaging channels and claimed by recipients. Developers can integrate privacy payments by calling privacy bridge contracts in EVM-compatible environments.
match.name: Payy

match.introduce: zipcoin ($ZC) is an Ethereum ERC-20 inspired by the currency in the novel Snowmoon. Users zip ZC or ETH into a privacy pool, unzip any amount to any address with a browser-built zero-knowledge proof, or burn coins to publish permanent on-chain messages. A sales tax on trades funds buybacks and burns.
match.one_liner: Ethereum privacy money with burn-to-speak messaging
match.name: zipcoin

match.introduce: DeepSwap is designed to empower institutions and high-net-worth individuals with private, secure, and efficient trading. By integrating Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC), and cross-chain atomic swaps, DeepSwap offers a fully compliant yet anonymous trading experience.
match.name: DeepSwap

match.introduce: Mosh is a token creation platform that funds launches via community Bundles, locks the opening supply in agent vaults, and uses AI market-making agents to manage trading capital. Funders earn a share of creator fees while agents buy and sell within limits to support liquidity, instead of distributing sellable tokens to early buyers.
match.one_liner: Token launchpad with AI market makers
match.name: Mosh

match.introduce: Chance is a verification layer for the AI agent economy. Its infrastructure, Agent Contracts, acts as an AI judge between an agent's intent and its on-chain execution: it verifies every order, releases it from escrow only on a pass, and settles with a receipt. Before execution, Chance checks the proposed action against the user's intent, returns a verdict with reasoning, and leaves a tamper-evident, independently verifiable record. The verdict is signed by a key in a hardware-isolated environment and anchored to a blockchain for long-term auditability. Developers can call this verification service via API, or use its上层 products: Chance AI (agent platform) and Chance App (AI wallet).
match.name: Chance

match.introduce: Tari is a Layer1 blockchain protocol focused on privacy and user-friendliness. It uses Mimblewimble to hide transaction amounts and addresses, and RandomX for ASIC-resistant mining, enabling ordinary users to participate in proof-of-work via personal computers. The protocol emphasizes decentralization and fairness, aiming to lower the barrier to cryptocurrency usage.
match.name: Tari

match.introduce: Veil is a peer-to-peer prediction market and derivatives platform built on Augur, 0x, and Ethereum.
match.name: Veil

match.introduce: Jitter is a yield trading protocol based on Sui. Users can earn fixed returns or use leverage to make long returns.
match.name: Jitter

match.introduce: Stax is an on-chain index basket protocol on Robinhood Chain. Users deposit USDG to have the protocol purchase tokenized stocks in preset weights and mint a single ERC-20 basket token. Baskets can be redeemed at any time for USDG with no lockup. It supports official baskets such as Mag 7 and user-created custom baskets, all priced by Chainlink oracles and 1:1 backed by underlying holdings. A 0.25% fee is charged on mint and redeem, with 50% used to buy and burn STAX tokens.
match.one_liner: Robinhood Chain tokenized stock index protocol
match.name: Stax

match.introduce: DeepCore is a Web3 AI Agent ecosystem built on the MCP (Model Context Protocol), providing developers with standardized tools and infrastructure to build, deploy, and collaborate on AI agents. Its core capabilities include: connecting multi-chain data (e.g., Ethereum, Solana) and off-chain services through a unified interface, supporting smart contract interaction, DeFi strategy execution, and on-chain data analysis. Developers can quickly assemble agents using its modular components and enable inter-agent collaboration and transactions via a decentralized network. Usage involves creating agents through APIs or a developer console, configuring data sources and execution logic, and leveraging its security verification mechanisms (e.g., zero-knowledge proofs and trusted execution environments) to ensure operational trust.
match.one_liner: A Web3 AI Agent collaboration platform based on the MCP protocol
match.name: DeepCore

match.introduce: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain platform that adopts an object-centric data model and the Move programming language. It enables developers to build smart contracts by defining object ownership for parallel transaction execution. Developers write, test and deploy Move contracts in the Sui environment to manage on-chain assets and data states.
match.one_liner: Sui is an object-centric Layer 1 blockchain
match.name: Sui

match.introduce: Gloam is the privacy layer for Robinhood Chain, offering shielded balances, private payments, and selective disclosure. Users park assets in a vault and trade tokenized stocks or crypto with zero-knowledge proofs that verify settlement without revealing amounts or strategy. The SDK lets any app or agent integrate private execution without building proving infrastructure.
match.name: Gloam

match.introduce: Overcall is an on-chain skill-based market. Its first product, Channels, lets a user draw a price channel with width, tilt, and duration, then bet Survive if price stays inside the walls or Breach if a wall breaks first. Odds lock at open. Hold to expiry for the full multiple, cash out early, or lose if a wall is hit. Prices come from decentralized oracles; positions settle on-chain against a neutral vault rather than another trader. Users can also back or fade other people’s channels.
match.name: Overcall

match.introduce: Leap is a non-custodial super wallet for Web3 that allows users to send, swap, and stake tokens.
match.name: Leap

match.introduce: Walrus is a decentralized storage protocol built on the Sui blockchain, focused on verifiable storage of large-scale unstructured data. It uses Red Stuff erasure coding to split data into Slivers distributed across a node network, where any combination of nodes can collect enough Slivers to reconstruct the original data, ensuring availability even if some nodes go offline. Each data Blob has a unique content-based ID, and storage nodes sign availability certificates that are recorded on-chain, forming publicly verifiable proofs of storage.
match.one_liner: A verifiable decentralized storage protocol on Sui
match.name: Walrus

match.introduce: Darkpool is a decentralized trading network that encapsulates automated trading strategies into on-chain autonomous Agent Vaults. It enables users to create or invest in AI-driven strategies, with private execution via encrypted orders and batch auctions, while a validator network ensures settlement correctness. Its mechanisms include order encryption, ZK proofs, and on-chain settlement, aiming to deliver transparent and verifiable automated trading.
match.name: Darkpool

match.introduce: Stellar is an open-source Layer 1 blockchain network launched in 2014 and restarted in 2015 with the Stellar Consensus Protocol (SCP). It focuses on asset issuance and payment settlement: any account can issue tokenized assets (such as fiat-backed stablecoins) and enable fast, low-cost cross-border transfers via the built-in decentralized exchange and path payments. Users must hold XLM to pay transaction fees and meet minimum account balances (base reserve), and can choose to accept specific assets through trustlines. SCP is a federated Byzantine agreement protocol where validators reach consensus based on publicly declared trust relationships, requiring neither proof-of-work mining nor token staking. Its smart contract platform, Soroban, supports contracts written in Rust, extending programmable finance applications.
match.name: Stellar

match.introduce: Centrifuge is an open decentralized infrastructure for on-chain asset management and real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The platform enables asset managers to tokenize institutional-grade assets—such as credit, real estate, and treasuries—into freely transferable tokens for use across DeFi ecosystems. Its core components include a compliant framework for asset origination, Anemoy (a full-service asset management arm for fund structuring), and Proof-of-Index infrastructure for tokenizing structured financial products like S&P 500 index funds.
match.one_liner: The on-chain ecosystem for structured credit
match.name: Centrifuge

match.introduce: Blockchain.com is a comprehensive cryptocurrency service platform offering digital asset wallets, an exchange, a blockchain explorer, and developer APIs. Users can securely store, send, and receive various cryptocurrencies through its wallet, trade spot and derivatives on the exchange, and participate in lending, staking, and other financial services. Its blockchain explorer allows querying on-chain transaction records, and API services facilitate developers in building applications. The platform employs security measures such as cold storage to protect user assets.
match.name: Blockchain.com

data.description: DexLaunch is a multi-chain token launchpad supporting bonding curves, presales, and direct V3/V4 pool launches, with protocol revenue across chains distributed to DXL holders.

OpenLaunch is an open-source zero platform fee token launchpad on Base and Robinhood Chain. Users create a fixed-supply token, Uniswap v4 pool, and permanently locked liquidity position in one transaction. The platform takes no fees, only gas is paid. Creators can set 0%, 1% or 3% trading fees to named recipients or burn them.

MerryForge is a fair-launch token marketplace on Robinhood Chain where creators issue fixed-supply community tokens, trade via transparent bonding curves, and graduate into locked AMM liquidity pools upon reaching raise caps.
Delpho is Hyperliquid’s productive dollar layer, transforming crypto collateral into liquidity that preserves directionality and earns real yield.

Textile FX is an on-chain FX rail for stablecoins. Users request a firm quote for a pair and size; independent makers price it, and the swap settles atomically in one non-custodial transaction. Live corridors include local-currency and asset-backed stablecoins against USD stables on Celo, BNB Chain, Ethereum and others.

data.one_liner: On-chain randomized tokenized stock acquisition protocol
data.description: StockRip is a blockchain-based randomized acquisition protocol focused on tokenized stocks (e.g., Apple, Tesla). It allows users to bundle tokenized shares (including fractional shares) into a basket and deposit ETH as backing. This backing determines the basket's selection weight in the pool and forms an irrevocable standing bid to reacquire the basket. Any participant can pay the pool-derived acquisition price to randomly receive a stock position from the basket. Its core mechanism uses a pre-committed hash chain to ensure randomness is transparent and tamper-proof, offering a fair, non-traditional liquidity method for tokenized stocks.

Pi Network is a mobile-based blockchain network designed to lower the barrier to cryptocurrency participation, enabling ordinary users to mine and build the ecosystem using their phones. It employs a variant of the Stellar Consensus Protocol (SCP), where users simply tap once daily to confirm identity and earn mining rewards without significant electricity or specialized hardware. Its core mechanism leverages a social trust graph to maintain network consensus, aiming to create a low-barrier digital currency ecosystem maintained by its users.

data.one_liner: One-stop crypto trading and payment platform
data.description: Crypto.com is a comprehensive cryptocurrency platform offering trading, payment, wallet, and decentralized finance (DeFi) services. It enables users to buy, sell, and hold various cryptocurrencies via mobile app or web interface, and spend crypto assets through Visa cards for everyday purchases. The platform includes a centralized exchange, a self-custody wallet, and Web3 applications built on the Cronos blockchain, allowing users to move assets between modules and participate in staking, lending, and liquidity farming. Its core mechanisms include fiat on/off ramps, an order-book matching engine, and on-chain settlement, designed to bridge traditional finance and the crypto ecosystem.

RaiseHood is a fixed-price raise pad on Robinhood Chain where projects sell tokens at a set price in ETH, USDG, or Robinhood stock tokens, with liquidity permanently locked for 69 years once the soft cap is met.

Unihood is a token launch platform based on Uniswap V4 on Robinhood Chain. It builds an automatically thickened price floor through a 1% transaction fee (80% goes to the creator, 5% is injected into the "buy wall" as a real buy order below the price, and 15% goes to the platform). The token is marked "graduated" when the market value is $60,000, but the trading mechanism remains unchanged.

Enhanced is a decentralized structured yield layer that uses derivatives strategies to help users generate returns from onchain assets. It connects users with institutional market makers via an RFQ auction mechanism: users deposit assets (e.g., PAXG), market makers bid to purchase options, and users receive premiums upfront. Products include vaults and manual trading—vaults automate covered call strategies with compound or income modes; manual mode allows users to customize strike price, tenor, and other parameters. All transactions are signed and settled onchain.

MasterCard is an American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York. It offers a range of payment transaction processing and other related-payment services (such as travel-related payments and bookings).

Tempo is a high-performance Layer1 blockchain designed for payment, developed by Stripe and Paradigm. With support for all major stablecoins, Tempo enables high-throughput, low-cost global transactions for any business use case.

Syntetika is an on-chain protocol that tokenizes institutional-grade investment strategies, offering a cbBTC vault. Users deposit cbBTC and receive hBTC, an ERC-4626 token representing a share, with NAV attested by an independent administrator and yield accruing automatically within the token. The strategy is managed by Hilbert Capital, employing market-neutral approaches (e.g., perpetual futures basis trading), with assets held by independent custodians and audited for transparency. Users enter by depositing cbBTC and redeem at NAV, subject to a subscription and redemption cycle.

data.one_liner: Uniswap v4 hook that rebates arbitrage to traders and LPs
data.description: What The Hook is a Uniswap v4 swap rebate hook that captures cross-pool arbitrage when prices diverge between connected pools and redistributes realized profit as trader rebates and LP rewards inside the same transaction. Third-party tokens can attach the hook at pool creation to keep that value on-chain for participants.

Bonker is a multi-chain token Launchpad that lets users deploy an ERC-20 token, create a Uniswap v4 pool, permanently lock liquidity, and configure creator rewards — all in a single transaction, via a message or web app.

Spiral Stake is a non-custodial leveraged looping protocol designed exclusively for maximizing stablecoin yields. Building on Pendle’s PT infrastructure, Spiral Stake optimizes borrowing costs across Morpho lending pools to enable stable, predictable leveraged yields that function like high-yield bonds with DeFi upside potential.

FairLaunch is a fair launch platform specifically designed for cryptocurrency token launches, dedicated to eliminating bots, insiders, and whale advantages, giving everyone an equal opportunity to participate in token launches.

data.one_liner: Building trusted infrastructure for the borderless economy
data.description: With a commitment to ensuring strong and lasting support for blockchain innovation, the Algorand Foundation fosters an open and transparent system where anyone can participate, develop, and innovate on the permissionless Algorand protocol, guided by the vision of an inclusive economy.

data.one_liner: The treasury layer for dollar-denominated digital assets
data.description: Vetro is a funding layer for USD-denominated digital assets.
Coinbarrel is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain that enables atomic token launches in a single transaction via Uniswap V4 Hook V5, with permanently locked liquidity for every token.

IGNIX is a universal token launch platform deployed on X Layer. Through the Bonding Curve and customizable treasury mechanism, creators can customize the transaction tax distribution method and support the integration of AI agents.

data.one_liner: Tokenized US stock market-making protocol on Uniswap v4
data.description: Fables is a non-custodial tokenized US stock market-making protocol built on Uniswap v4 Hook framework, deployed on Robinhood Chain. Users deposit assets, select price ranges, and earn trading fees through dynamic fees calculated in real-time by Hook contracts, which also record market-making shares. Its fee mechanism is determined by three models—calendar, fixed benchmark, and directional—to mitigate risks from mismatches between 24/7 on-chain trading and US stock market hours. The protocol adopts a ve(3,3) governance mechanism, with PROLOGUE as a pre-governance token redeemable for the governance token FABLES.

data.one_liner: Full-stack operating platform for token-native ventures
data.description: Umia is a full-stack operating platform for token-native ventures, integrating project launch, community fundraising, and on-chain governance. It provides infrastructure for legal entity formation, token issuance, and treasury management, and pioneers a "decision market" mechanism: key proposals are turned into prediction markets where participants express views by trading conditional tokens on different outcomes. The market settles via time-weighted average price (TWAP) and automatically executes the winning outcome. This mechanism aims to replace traditional voting with market signals, enhancing governance efficiency and treasury transparency.

data.one_liner: Launchpad for memecoins paired with tokenized stocks
data.description: Stonx is a launchpad on Base enabling users to create and trade memecoins paired with tokenized equities such as NVDA and TSLA. Tokens feature a fixed 1B supply, permanently locked liquidity, and trading fees split with creators. Built on Doppler and Uniswap v4, the platform is non-custodial and independent.

PerpMe is a token launchpad on HyperEVM. Every launch mints its full supply into a single-sided Uniswap V3 position on PRJX and sends the LP NFT to the PerpMe locker, which has no function to decrease liquidity or move the position — so the liquidity is locked permanently. Trading fees from each pool are split 60/40 between the coin's creator and the platform.

data.one_liner: An on-chain lending protocol connecting the real economy
data.description: Soil is a blockchain-based lending protocol that bridges traditional finance and the crypto world. It allocates stablecoins (e.g., USDC) deposited by investors into fully collateralized SME loans through on-chain vaults, generating fixed returns. The protocol offers Liquid Vaults (flexible access) and Credit Vaults (fixed-term lockup), and supports XRP-denominated yield. Loans are selected by a professional team and backed by legal safeguards and risk controls.
token.select is a fair-launch token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.
Astro is a no-code DAO launch platform for launching decentralized autonomous organizations on Near. It empowers groups from all over the world to make decisions together, collectively.

data.one_liner: Operating system for real-world asset tokenization
data.description: tx is an operating system for real-world asset tokenization, combining technology, compliance and liquidity. It offers a purpose-built Layer-1, smart-token compliance controls, a self-custody super app and RWA marketplace infrastructure connecting issuers, regulated entities and investors for issuance, lifecycle management and trading of tokenized assets.
Bisonfi is a PropAMM launched by SOL treasury company Forward Industries.

data.one_liner: ICP multichain sovereign wallet and execution layer
data.description: Menese Protocol is a multichain execution layer on the Internet Computer. Using chain-key cryptography, canisters build and sign transactions for sovereign wallets, cross-chain swaps, liquidity routing and automation across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and 20+ other chains, without custodial bridges.

Morpheus is a decentralized AI inference marketplace that coordinates AI model providers and consumers via blockchain smart contracts. It allows users to access AI inference through an API or a local node, without relying on centralized services. Its mechanism includes: providers register models, consumers pay per session duration, and funds are escrowed and settled on-chain.

MassPay is a global financial orchestration platform enabling businesses to collect and send payments to recipients in more than 180 countries across multiple rails, currencies, and payout methods, including local bank transfers, mobile wallets, real-time payments, and stablecoins.

Pangolin is a decentralized exchange protocol on the Avalanche blockchain. It employs an automated market maker model to enable token swaps. Users connect a compatible wallet to select trading pairs for swaps or supply assets to liquidity pools to earn a share of trading fees. Documentation outlines core mechanisms including constant product formula pricing and liquidity management processes.

data.one_liner: A compliant investment manager focused on crypto assets
data.description: Bitwise is an asset management firm focused exclusively on the cryptocurrency space, dedicated to providing compliant and transparent digital asset investment solutions for institutional and individual investors. Its business spans index funds, active management strategies, and model portfolios, offered through formats such as ETFs, private funds, and trusts. Bitwise is known for rigorous research and risk management, helping investors efficiently allocate to major crypto assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum while managing associated risks.

data.one_liner: Dogecoin's app layer: a ZK-proof-based smart contract platform
data.description: DogeOS is an application layer for the Dogecoin ecosystem, created by the team behind the MyDoge wallet, aiming to bring smart contracts and decentralized applications to Dogecoin. It leverages zero-knowledge proof technology (such as the proposed OP_CHECKZKP opcode) to build a zk-rollup, where batches of transactions are compressed into a single proof verified on the Dogecoin mainnet, enhancing scalability without altering Dogecoin's core. Developers can use Ethereum tools like Solidity, while end users connect via compatible wallets.

data.one_liner: A crypto-native fund focused on yield
data.description: SharpByte Capital is a crypto-native investment fund founded by Marco Manoppo, focused on capturing asymmetric opportunities arising from the combination of on-chain yield and off-chain industry resources. The fund is centered on yield strategies, covering areas such as DeFi and RWA tokenization, while also providing strategic advisory and liquidity management services to early-stage protocols. The founder previously worked at Primitive Ventures and Digital Asset Research, bringing institutional research and investment experience.
Hookers is the incubator for hooked markets.

OpenStock is an on-chain pre-IPO investment platform that allows users to deposit USDC to receive vault tokens representing IPO allocation claims, which can be redeemed for USDC at net value after the company lists.

data.one_liner: Digital asset market maker and quantitative trading firm
data.description: Keyrock is a market maker and quantitative trading firm focused on digital assets, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. It leverages proprietary self-adaptive algorithms and high-frequency trading technology to provide liquidity and market-making services for cryptocurrency exchanges, token projects, and institutional clients. Its core activities include providing two-sided quotes on centralized and decentralized exchanges to tighten bid-ask spreads, managing inventory risk through quantitative strategies, and designing liquidity solutions for newly issued tokens. Clients can access customized liquidity support via its API or partnership frameworks.

data.one_liner: Institutional-grade digital asset market making and OTC trading platform
data.description: Flowdesk is a digital asset trading and liquidity provider specializing in institutional OTC trading, market making, and token liquidity solutions. It connects centralized and decentralized exchanges through proprietary trading technology, offering deep liquidity, algorithmic execution, and risk management tools. Clients can access block trading, token issuance support, and customized market-making services. Flowdesk is regulated by the French AMF and registered with Dubai's VARA, serving global institutional clients in a compliant manner.

data.one_liner: Institutional-grade digital asset trading technology platform
data.description: Architect is an institutional-grade digital asset trading technology company that provides high-performance, customizable trading infrastructure for professional trading teams. Its core product is an API-first trading platform supporting multiple asset classes including spot and derivatives, integrating tools such as smart order routing, algorithmic execution, risk management, and real-time monitoring. Institutions can seamlessly connect the platform to their own trading systems via open APIs and WebSocket interfaces to automate strategies like market making and arbitrage. Architect emphasizes low latency, high throughput, and modular design, enabling traders to flexibly build and execute complex trading workflows.

data.one_liner: The world's largest digital asset exchange
data.description: Binance is one of the world's largest digital asset exchanges, aiming to be the infrastructure services provider for the blockchain ecosystem. It features a portfolio of crypto products and offerings, such as trading and finance, education, data and research, social good, investment and incubation, decentralization and infrastructure solutions, and more.
Archade is a short-video social platform on the Solana blockchain, with built-in DEX and token launch functionality.

data.one_liner: Algorithmic trading and digital asset liquidity provider
data.description: Presto is an algorithmic trading and digital asset financial services firm, specializing in market making, over-the-counter (OTC) trading, and liquidity provision. It leverages proprietary trading systems and quantitative models to execute high-frequency strategies across centralized and decentralized markets, offering tailored execution solutions for institutional clients.

data.one_liner: Aster is a decentralized perp DEX
data.description: Aster is a decentralized derivatives exchange built on its own Aster Chain, supporting multi-chain asset trading. It offers perpetual contracts, spot trading, and a 1001x leverage mode that simplifies execution by trading directly against on-chain liquidity. It also provides privacy protection through zero-knowledge proofs, encrypting orders and concealing trader identities and positions. Aster integrates grid trading, yield products such as liquid staking and interest-bearing stablecoins, as well as pre-listing contracts and equity perpetuals.
GoonFi is an AMM trading protocol based on Solana.
Tessera V is a Solana-based PropAMM operated by Wintermute.

SoFi(Nasdaq: SOFI) is a one-stop digital financial platform that provides comprehensive financial services to individuals and businesses, including student and personal loans, home loans and refinancing, credit cards, bank accounts, investments, insurance, and a B2B fintech platform.
LEVR is decentralized leveraged sports betting that transforms this landscape by enabling up to 5x leverage on bets, unlocking new possibilities for bettors.

data.one_liner: A quantitative trading and asset curation firm focused on crypto and DeFi
data.description: JPEG Trading is a quantitative and proprietary trading firm specializing in cryptocurrency and decentralized finance (DeFi) markets. Its core operations include high-frequency and mid-frequency trading, liquidity provision, and an emerging asset curation service. For curation, JPEG Trading combines deep technical analysis with financial due diligence to actively evaluate and select promising on-chain assets, deploying its own capital to back these assessments and facilitate the adoption of high-quality collateral within DeFi protocols.
