Its first curated asset is a tokenized gold product.

zERC20 is a cross-chain private ERC-20 protocol that enables private transfers using the same operations as regular ERC-20 tokens. It works directly from wallets like MetaMask. Users wrap assets such as USDC, ETH, BNB and JPYC 1:1 into zUSDC, zETH and similar z-tokens, send them to a burn address with no private key, and recipients redeem equivalent amounts to any unlinked address via zero-knowledge proofs. The mechanism is based on EIP-7503 zkWormhole, making private transfers indistinguishable from ordinary ones on-chain.

data.one_liner: Decentralized AI inference and settlement network
data.description: DGrid is a decentralized AI inference network that connects model providers and users through a standardized RPC interface, with blockchain-based settlement and verification. It offers a unified API to access various LLMs and Agents, supports intelligent routing, pay-per-use via the x402 protocol, on-chain settlement, and result verification based on Proof of Quality. Developers can simply point their OpenAI SDK base_url to the DGrid gateway to use compatible endpoints, while model providers can deploy nodes to perform inference and earn rewards. Its mechanisms include distributed node execution, real-time performance reporting, decentralized governance (AI DAO), and tamper-proof on-chain audit records, aiming to reduce AI integration costs and increase transparency.
DAMM Capital, a company focused on decentralized capital management solutions, develops customized solutions for users to address their DeFi needs.

Dune is a blockchain data analytics platform that allows users to query, analyze, and visualize public blockchain data using SQL. It decodes and indexes raw on-chain data into structured tables covering transactions, token transfers, DEX trades, and more. Users can write queries in a web editor, create charts and dashboards, and share them publicly. All queries are public by default, enabling forking and modification of others' queries for further analysis. The platform supports EVM-compatible chains and non-EVM chains like Solana. Its technical architecture includes the DuneSQL query engine and distributed execution to handle large-scale datasets.

EARN is a liquidity protocol for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Holders deposit into automated vaults or Omnipools. A vault markets a single stock pair. An Omnipool holds up to eight tokens in one shared market so LPs keep basket exposure and earn fees from every swap in the pool. Swap fee is 0.30%, with 90% to LPs and 10% to the protocol. The app also has looped LP positions, Longbow credit markets, and an agent skill file. Protocol fees buy $EARN for stakers.

data.one_liner: A protocol tokenizing traditional domains for cross-chain trading
data.description: Doma Protocol is a decentralized domain protocol that tokenizes traditional DNS domains, enabling them to be traded, borrowed against, and integrated into Web3 applications on the blockchain. It separates domain ownership from management through two token types: an Ownership Token (DOT) representing the domain asset itself, and a Service Token (DST) controlling management functions like DNS records. Its technical core is cross-chain messaging, supporting the transfer of domain assets between different blockchains such as Ethereum and Solana, while maintaining compatibility with the existing internet DNS system.

data.one_liner: Swiss non-custodial crypto wallet and tokenization platform
data.description: Mt Pelerin is a Swiss-based crypto fintech company offering non-custodial (self-custodial) digital asset services. Its core product is Bridge Wallet, a mobile app that lets users manage their private keys directly and buy, sell, or exchange multiple cryptocurrencies with fiat, supporting assets on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and various EVM-compatible chains. The platform provides personal IBANs, enabling users to deposit or withdraw fiat via bank transfer, and can automatically convert salaries into crypto. The company operates Bridge Protocol, an open-source multi-chain tokenization platform for issuing and managing compliant security tokens, with on-chain KYC/AML rule enforcement.

data.one_liner: Credit layer lending protocol on Robinhood Chain
data.description: Longbow is a decentralized credit layer protocol built on Robinhood Chain, focusing on lending markets. It allows users to deposit USDG to provide liquidity and earn interest, or borrow USDG using various assets as collateral, including tokenized stocks, crypto assets, RWAs, and memecoins. The protocol adopts an isolated market design, where each market independently sets oracles, liquidation parameters, and supply caps to isolate risk. The settlement layer is based on Morpho Blue, with pricing via Chainlink oracles and Uniswap TWAP. The protocol token BOW is used for governance and capturing protocol fees, supporting staking, buybacks, and other mechanisms. All contracts are verified on Blockscout for transparency.

data.one_liner: Crypto info aggregator focused on Polymarket
data.description: NUKES.FUN is a crypto-native information aggregation and trading tool platform focused on the prediction market Polymarket. Its core function is to aggregate global event feeds, identify high-volatility sectors (such as geopolitics), and provide market intelligence to users. The platform presents a real-time information feed through a clean interface, helping users capture market opportunities.

PEZ.family is a zero-platform-fee token launchpad on Robinhood Chain that uses a bonding curve mechanism, graduating tokens to permanently locked Uniswap V4 pools once sold out, with creators retaining 100% of trade fees.

data.one_liner: A dual-yield DeFi liquidity protocol on Uniswap v4
data.description: TwoFold is a DeFi liquidity protocol built on Uniswap v4 and Robinhood Chain. By deploying an unmodified Uniswap v4 hook, it automatically deposits idle USDG assets from pools into Steakhouse's Morpho Vaults V2 to earn lending yield, while simultaneously utilizing those funds to provide liquidity during swaps to earn trading fees, achieving dual yield on the same capital. The protocol supports trading pairs such as WETH, TWO, and tokenized equities like SPY, QQQ, NVDA. The protocol also features governance voting and a permanent liquidity lock mechanism.

NEAR Protocol is a sharded decentralized computing platform designed to provide a blockchain environment with high throughput, low latency, and low fees. It supports smart contracts written in Rust and JavaScript/TypeScript, and simplifies user experience through account abstraction, such as human-readable account names. NEAR also offers chain abstraction capabilities for cross-chain interoperability and AI-related tools.

Perps Hood is a launchpad where every coin is backed by a live leveraged perpetual owned by that coin's own on-chain sub-wallet. Trading fees fund the perp; profits buy back and burn supply; drawdowns only add margin. The position never closes and nothing unwinds at graduation.

Astar Fi is an onchain personal finance manager that lets users view onchain net worth and act via Save, Earn and Invest; it reads the portfolio without taking custody. Save displays net worth split between investment and money, allocation by category, protocol or network, plus concentration and liquidity. Earn shows vault current yield, 30-day average, risk tier and rating, with underlying allocation, collateral, risk details and contract address. Incubated by Astar Network.

Qiro Finance is a decentralized private credit protocol designed to connect stablecoin investors with vetted asset originators. Its core mechanism is a distributed underwriting network, where independent nodes run data-driven credit models to evaluate borrowers and generate reports, addressing risk pricing and transparency issues in on-chain credit. The protocol employs a senior/junior tranche structure: investors can purchase senior tranches for yield, while underwriter nodes and asset originators are required to hold junior tranches as a risk buffer, aligning their interests with loan performance. Qiro provides on-chain financing channels for real-world assets (RWA) through standardized credit pools and on-chain data monitoring.
Dirac Finance is an institutional grade decentralized options vault.Earn yield through options, structured products, and principal-protected coupon notes strategies
Elara Finance is a treasury management protocol generating real yield through proprietary concentrated liquidity.

data.one_liner: A token launchpad and DEX on Arc
data.description: TOLLY is a decentralized token launchpad and DEX built on the Arc network. It enables one-click fair token launches, with liquidity automatically added in USDC and permanently locked, eliminating migration and rug-pull risks. A 1% fee is charged on every trade, split as follows: 64% to the creator, 12% to token holders weighted by holding time, 10% to protocol operations, 9% to buy back and burn TOLLY, and 5% to buy back and burn the traded token itself. All fee distributions are hardcoded in the contract with no admin keys. trading other Arc tokens on the platform generates fees that are used to buy back and burn TOLLY, allowing TOLLY to capture value from the entire ecosystem's trading volume.
Tsunami is a token launchpad based on Ink.

Humanity Protocol is a blockchain-based digital identity verification protocol, with its core mechanism being "Proof of Humanity." It aims to verify that a user is a unique real human in a privacy-preserving and low-cost manner, using biometrics such as palm recognition. It leverages zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) and decentralized identifiers (DIDs) to allow users to prove their identity or specific attributes (e.g., age, residency) to applications without revealing personal sensitive data. Developers can integrate identity verification into their applications via its SDK and API for use cases like anti-Sybil in airdrops, community governance, and credential issuance.

Lumerin is a decentralized hashrate routing protocol built on blockchain. It enables peer-to-peer trading and routing of hashpower via smart contracts. Users deploy nodes to connect miners or pools for buying, selling, allocating and settling hashpower. The protocol uses on-chain contracts to manage orders, payments and execution without centralized intermediaries.

The Interfold is a decentralized confidential computing protocol that combines Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), and Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to execute computations directly on encrypted data via a distributed network of Ciphernodes, without trusting any single centralized party. It supports sealed-bid auctions, private voting, and collaborative analysis of sensitive data: data providers encrypt inputs with a shared public key and publish commitments onchain; nodes are selected via sortition to form a Ciphernode Committee (CiCo), which generates keys, performs the computation, and produces verifiable proofs; the final result is decrypted only when a preset threshold is met, keeping data encrypted throughout.
Genius.fun is a token launchpad on BNB Chain where users create tokens and trade them on a bonding curve with BNB.

Mog is a self-bootstrapping perpetual DEX offering up to 1,000x leverage on stocks, memes and more, with zero funding fees and zero slippage from order size. Trades face the protocol treasury at oracle prices with no order book or market makers; trading activity itself builds treasury liquidity for future payouts.

AntSeed is a decentralized peer-to-peer network for AI services, designed to eliminate intermediaries in AI calls. It enables providers to directly sell AI inference and agent services to buyers, who discover, route, and pay through a local proxy. It builds a decentralized directory on BEP 5 DHT, retrieves provider metadata via HTTP endpoints, and employs multi-factor scoring (price, latency, capacity, reputation, etc.) for intelligent routing, while also supporting peer pinning and Skills filtering.

data.one_liner: Splits tokenized stocks into price and dividend components on-chain
data.description: Pare is a DeFi protocol on Robinhood Chain that splits tokenized stocks into separate price and dividend components. Users deposit a stock token (e.g., AAPL, SPY, QQQ) and receive equal amounts of Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT). PT represents price exposure without dividends and redeems at face value at maturity; YT captures the entire dividend stream until maturity. Both tokens are tradable on Uniswap v3, PT can be posted as collateral on Morpho for borrowing, and the two can be merged back into the original stock at any time for free. The protocol tracks dividends via the ERC-8056 multiplier, and fees are used to buy back and burn PARE tokens.

Foci is a memecoin launchpad on Arc that lets users create tokens in one click. The platform lists trending, new and graduated tokens with filters by market cap and 24h volume, enabling discovery and trading of memecoins quoted in USDC.

DeTrade is a multi-asset trading platform designed to connect traditional finance with the on-chain economy. Through futures, binary options, spread options, CFDs, copy trading, demo trading and prediction markets, DeTrade provides eligible users with a tiered product experience across a range of trading scenarios.

GT Protocol is a Web3 AI investment protocol that connects CeFi, DeFi, and NFT markets through a conversational AI interface. Core features include: AI trading agents that execute strategies automatically, supporting trading on platforms such as Binance and Hyperliquid; an AI strategy backtesting tool that lets users describe trading ideas in natural language and automatically generates and tests strategies; copy trading that replicates strategies from verified traders; and an MCP server that enables AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT to access trading functions directly. Usage: users connect exchanges via API keys or wallets through Magic, authorizing trades in a non-custodial manner, with funds always remaining under user control. The platform also offers demo trading for risk-free strategy testing.

Spine Finance is a provable lending protocol on Ethereum and EVM-compatible blockchains specializing in facilitating fixed-interest-rate financial transactions through an efficient automated market maker mechanism called BondMM.Spine enable users to efficiently lend and borrow money at fixed interest rates by building on top of existing variable-rate lending protocols including Morpho, Aave, Venus, Compound, Euler, and more.
Kaleidoswap is a decentralized trading platform that combines Bitcoin's security, Lightning Network's speed, and RGB Protocol programmability in a single open-source desktop application.

Flipcash is a digital currency creation platform built on the Solana blockchain, enabling users to create their own community currencies. Its core mechanism is a reserve model: each currency is pegged to USDF (a stablecoin issued in partnership with Coinbase) through a fixed pricing curve, ensuring liquidity. Users can buy or sell currencies directly from the reserve with transparent, predictable prices. The platform supports instant swaps between currencies and emphasizes non-custodial features, giving users full control over their assets. This design aims to solve the common problems of low liquidity and high price volatility in traditional community tokens, allowing communities to build sustainable monetary systems.

DTCC is the premier post-trade market infrastructure for the global financial services industry. From 20 locations around the world, DTCC, through its subsidiaries, automates, centralizes, and standardizes the processing of financial transactions, mitigating risk, increasing transparency, enhancing performance and driving efficiency for thousands of broker/dealers, custodian banks and asset managers.

data.one_liner: Self-custodial private payments wallet on Aztec
data.description: zk.money is a self-custodial privacy wallet on Aztec Network, built by Aztec Labs. Users send and receive crypto via readable tags; balances, amounts and counterparties stay private by default. Funds deposit from Ethereum, move privately inside the network, and can withdraw back to Ethereum.

Orbio is an AI inference-credit marketplace on Robinhood Chain. Users call 400-plus models such as Claude Fable, GPT Astra, and Gemini through an OpenAI-compatible API. Requests go to the named model; prompts are not stored. Staking ORBIO earns CREDIT. One CREDIT equals one dollar of Orbio inference and can be held, transferred, traded on an on-chain order book, or activated, which burns it into an API balance. Agents can buy CREDIT without staking.

Three Protocol is a blockchain-based decentralized marketplace protocol designed to replace traditional centralized employment and e-commerce platforms. It leverages zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP) to protect user privacy, manages transactions and disputes through a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) and Tri-Proof smart contracts, and uses an AI model to match supply and demand.

United Founders Group (UFG) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 token on Robinhood Chain backed by an immutable ETH treasury. It is the first product of a broader onchain treasury platform, built on a deliberately simple model: creator fees flow into a transparent ETH treasury, and UFG holders can redeem their pro-rata share of ETH at any time, with a 2% exit fee that ensures the ETH backing per remaining token never declines. The platform plans to expand with additional experimental strategies, each in its own contract with clear disclosures, while UFG itself serves as the platform treasury, governed by fixed rules with no owner or upgrade path.

data.one_liner: Arc token launch and trading platform
data.description: Faze is a token launchpad on Arc Chain. Users launch tokens with custom bonding targets that graduate into locked Uniswap v4 liquidity pools with USDC fees. Launchers can adjust pool fees, transfer fee rights, enable liquidity compounding and token burns, and use two-step on-chain community takeovers. Faze Terminal provides one-tap buys, watchlists, KOL feeds and built-in wallet PNL analytics.

BT.Finance is a multi-chain smart DeFi yield aggregator that targets the best and sustainable yield for tokens. The project is launched by the community and will be run by a DAO that is governed by votes from the community. The Vaults are divided into three pools: Stable Profits Pool, High Yield Pool, and Smart Hybrid Pool, to cater to users with various risk tolerances.

data.one_liner: Upgrade stablecoins into yield-bearing non-custodial overlaid assets
data.description: Overlayer is a non-custodial smart-contract protocol that wraps stablecoins such as USDC and USDT into liquid, non-rebasing, composable overlaid assets (e.g., C+ and T+). Users mint overlaid assets at a deterministic 1:1 ratio by depositing supported stablecoins and can use them across DeFi. If yield is desired, users can stake the overlaid assets to receive a separate share-based representation whose value accrues via exchange-rate appreciation, with yield sourced from realized returns at external venues such as Aave. The protocol does not rely on leverage, forced lockups, or token emissions; core operations (mint, redeem, stake, unstake) are permissionless on-chain actions, and LayerZero enables cross-chain transfer.

Securitize is a real-world asset (RWA) tokenization platform providing a full suite of compliant infrastructure from issuance to trading. Asset managers can convert traditional assets such as fund shares into digital securities on blockchain, using smart contracts for automated compliance and dividend distribution. The platform supports multiple blockchains including Ethereum and Solana, and integrates SEC-registered broker-dealer, digital transfer agent, alternative trading system (ATS), and fund administration services, covering the complete lifecycle of token issuance, investor management, secondary trading, and fund administration. Investors can trade tokenized private equity, credit, and other assets on its regulated ATS.

data.one_liner: Privacy cryptocurrency that hides transaction details with zero-knowledge proofs
data.description: Zcash is a blockchain-based privacy cryptocurrency derived from the Bitcoin codebase, which protects transaction privacy through zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs). It supports transparent and shielded addresses: transparent transactions resemble Bitcoin and are publicly visible, while shielded transactions encrypt the sender, receiver, and amount, decryptable only by holders of viewing keys.

data.one_liner: EVM blockchain for desci applications and DAOs
data.description: GenesisL1 is an EVM blockchain for desci applications and DAOs. GenesisL1 decentralize vital and open biological databases and datasets, machine learning models and weights (e.g. PDBbank, UniProt, Alphafold db, ProteinNet, IPD-IMGT/HLA, etc) with blockchain, writing data in blockchain and provide open source EVM dApps with environment for scientific research and education, for example NFT of molecular structures: MolNFT.ORG, or dataset constructor for machine learning tokenized with NFT and ProtCrud indexed with GenesisL1: DatasetNFT.org, or Web3 pairwise alignments implemented via smart contracts.

Papertrade is a synthetic perpetual contract protocol built on HyperEVM. Instead of relying on a traditional order book, it lets users trade directly against the protocol's liquidity pool (LP), using Hyperliquid's BBO mid price as the price source, achieving zero slippage, zero funding fees, and supporting high leverage. When opening a position, the user locks in that mid price as the entry price; when closing, profit and loss are settled at the latest mid price. The protocol does not charge users trading fees, but takes a percentage from profitable trades. When users lose or get liquidated, the loss goes into the LP, and the user receives PAPER tokens as compensation. PAPER tokens have no pre-mine and can be staked to share protocol revenue. This mechanism creates a counterparty relationship between the LP and users, sustained by token incentives.

tacit is bitcoin privacy protocol with shielded amounts, shielded addresses, anonymous spend via mixer pools, a native AMM, and trustless wrapped BTC — all settled on Bitcoin L1, privacy layered so each user picks the level that fits the use case.

Numerai is a decentralized data science competition platform focused on stock market prediction. It provides encrypted and obfuscated financial data, which data scientists use to build machine learning models to predict future stock performance. After submitting predictions, users can stake the native token NMR to participate in reward distribution; good predictions earn NMR rewards, while poor predictions are burned. The platform integrates all submitted predictions through a meta-model to guide its hedge fund trading. Numerai Signals allows users to submit signals using their own data, which are neutralized and evaluated for uniqueness. The mechanism aims to incentivize genuinely effective predictions while preventing overfitting.

Baibai is a prop AMM, a new type of decentralized exchange that quotes prices in real-time and dynamically adjusts liquidity depth. Unlike traditional amms, Baibai is designed to offer tighter spreads and better execution.

Arkade is an open-source execution engine built on Bitcoin. It processes transactions off-chain in a Virtual Mempool and inherits Bitcoin's security through batched on-chain settlement. Developers can use its SDK to build applications for payments, asset transfers, and smart contracts. Users submit transactions via an Operator, which executes them instantly off-chain and later anchors them to the Bitcoin network in batches. The mechanism relies on pre-signed Bitcoin transactions and operator cooperation, ensuring users retain control of their assets and can exit to the chain when necessary.

data.one_liner: Self-backed lending protocol on diamond standard
data.description: Statics Protocol is a DeFi lending protocol built on the EIP-2535 diamond standard, with a core mechanism of "self-backed lending": users deposit BasketTokens as collateral to borrow the corresponding underlying asset portfolio. The protocol adopts a dual-diamond architecture, separating user interactions from the collateral and solvency state of the Statics Dollar, reducing systemic risk. Loans are backed by the value of the basket tokens themselves, without oracle dependency, and liquidation risk is governed by collateral ratio constraints. The protocol also integrates with Uniswap v4 for liquidity and includes a fee-sharing mechanism.

data.one_liner: ZK privacy protocol for any existing wallet
data.description: Nullmask is a zero-knowledge privacy protocol that installs as a virtual network in any existing multichain wallet—no new wallet or seed required. Users shield assets into a private pool, then make untraceable transfers, withdrawals and swaps; zk proofs are generated client-side and submitted via a relayer so deposit and withdrawal stay unlinkable onchain.

Payy is a zero-knowledge privacy layer on Ethereum for stablecoin payments, offering private transfers, hidden balances, and selective auditability. It manages private state via a UTXO model and sparse Merkle tree. Users can use Payy Wallet or SDK to generate zero-knowledge proofs and bridge assets from the public EVM layer to the privacy layer, enabling transfers that hide sender, receiver, and amount. Payy Links encode payment intent into URLs that can be shared through messaging channels and claimed by recipients. Developers can integrate privacy payments by calling privacy bridge contracts in EVM-compatible environments.

data.one_liner: Ethereum privacy money with burn-to-speak messaging
data.description: zipcoin ($ZC) is an Ethereum ERC-20 inspired by the currency in the novel Snowmoon. Users zip ZC or ETH into a privacy pool, unzip any amount to any address with a browser-built zero-knowledge proof, or burn coins to publish permanent on-chain messages. A sales tax on trades funds buybacks and burns.

DeepSwap is designed to empower institutions and high-net-worth individuals with private, secure, and efficient trading. By integrating Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC), and cross-chain atomic swaps, DeepSwap offers a fully compliant yet anonymous trading experience.

data.one_liner: Token launchpad with AI market makers
data.description: Mosh is a token creation platform that funds launches via community Bundles, locks the opening supply in agent vaults, and uses AI market-making agents to manage trading capital. Funders earn a share of creator fees while agents buy and sell within limits to support liquidity, instead of distributing sellable tokens to early buyers.

Chance is a verification layer for the AI agent economy. Its infrastructure, Agent Contracts, acts as an AI judge between an agent's intent and its on-chain execution: it verifies every order, releases it from escrow only on a pass, and settles with a receipt. Before execution, Chance checks the proposed action against the user's intent, returns a verdict with reasoning, and leaves a tamper-evident, independently verifiable record. The verdict is signed by a key in a hardware-isolated environment and anchored to a blockchain for long-term auditability. Developers can call this verification service via API, or use its上层 products: Chance AI (agent platform) and Chance App (AI wallet).

Tari is a Layer1 blockchain protocol focused on privacy and user-friendliness. It uses Mimblewimble to hide transaction amounts and addresses, and RandomX for ASIC-resistant mining, enabling ordinary users to participate in proof-of-work via personal computers. The protocol emphasizes decentralization and fairness, aiming to lower the barrier to cryptocurrency usage.
Veil is a peer-to-peer prediction market and derivatives platform built on Augur, 0x, and Ethereum.
Jitter is a yield trading protocol based on Sui. Users can earn fixed returns or use leverage to make long returns.

data.one_liner: Robinhood Chain tokenized stock index protocol
data.description: Stax is an on-chain index basket protocol on Robinhood Chain. Users deposit USDG to have the protocol purchase tokenized stocks in preset weights and mint a single ERC-20 basket token. Baskets can be redeemed at any time for USDG with no lockup. It supports official baskets such as Mag 7 and user-created custom baskets, all priced by Chainlink oracles and 1:1 backed by underlying holdings. A 0.25% fee is charged on mint and redeem, with 50% used to buy and burn STAX tokens.

data.one_liner: A Web3 AI Agent collaboration platform based on the MCP protocol
data.description: DeepCore is a Web3 AI Agent ecosystem built on the MCP (Model Context Protocol), providing developers with standardized tools and infrastructure to build, deploy, and collaborate on AI agents. Its core capabilities include: connecting multi-chain data (e.g., Ethereum, Solana) and off-chain services through a unified interface, supporting smart contract interaction, DeFi strategy execution, and on-chain data analysis. Developers can quickly assemble agents using its modular components and enable inter-agent collaboration and transactions via a decentralized network. Usage involves creating agents through APIs or a developer console, configuring data sources and execution logic, and leveraging its security verification mechanisms (e.g., zero-knowledge proofs and trusted execution environments) to ensure operational trust.

data.one_liner: Sui is an object-centric Layer 1 blockchain
data.description: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain platform that adopts an object-centric data model and the Move programming language. It enables developers to build smart contracts by defining object ownership for parallel transaction execution. Developers write, test and deploy Move contracts in the Sui environment to manage on-chain assets and data states.

Gloam is the privacy layer for Robinhood Chain, offering shielded balances, private payments, and selective disclosure. Users park assets in a vault and trade tokenized stocks or crypto with zero-knowledge proofs that verify settlement without revealing amounts or strategy. The SDK lets any app or agent integrate private execution without building proving infrastructure.

Overcall is an on-chain skill-based market. Its first product, Channels, lets a user draw a price channel with width, tilt, and duration, then bet Survive if price stays inside the walls or Breach if a wall breaks first. Odds lock at open. Hold to expiry for the full multiple, cash out early, or lose if a wall is hit. Prices come from decentralized oracles; positions settle on-chain against a neutral vault rather than another trader. Users can also back or fade other people’s channels.
Leap is a non-custodial super wallet for Web3 that allows users to send, swap, and stake tokens.

data.one_liner: A verifiable decentralized storage protocol on Sui
data.description: Walrus is a decentralized storage protocol built on the Sui blockchain, focused on verifiable storage of large-scale unstructured data. It uses Red Stuff erasure coding to split data into Slivers distributed across a node network, where any combination of nodes can collect enough Slivers to reconstruct the original data, ensuring availability even if some nodes go offline. Each data Blob has a unique content-based ID, and storage nodes sign availability certificates that are recorded on-chain, forming publicly verifiable proofs of storage.

Darkpool is a decentralized trading network that encapsulates automated trading strategies into on-chain autonomous Agent Vaults. It enables users to create or invest in AI-driven strategies, with private execution via encrypted orders and batch auctions, while a validator network ensures settlement correctness. Its mechanisms include order encryption, ZK proofs, and on-chain settlement, aiming to deliver transparent and verifiable automated trading.

Stellar is an open-source Layer 1 blockchain network launched in 2014 and restarted in 2015 with the Stellar Consensus Protocol (SCP). It focuses on asset issuance and payment settlement: any account can issue tokenized assets (such as fiat-backed stablecoins) and enable fast, low-cost cross-border transfers via the built-in decentralized exchange and path payments. Users must hold XLM to pay transaction fees and meet minimum account balances (base reserve), and can choose to accept specific assets through trustlines. SCP is a federated Byzantine agreement protocol where validators reach consensus based on publicly declared trust relationships, requiring neither proof-of-work mining nor token staking. Its smart contract platform, Soroban, supports contracts written in Rust, extending programmable finance applications.

data.one_liner: The on-chain ecosystem for structured credit
data.description: Centrifuge is an open decentralized infrastructure for on-chain asset management and real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The platform enables asset managers to tokenize institutional-grade assets—such as credit, real estate, and treasuries—into freely transferable tokens for use across DeFi ecosystems. Its core components include a compliant framework for asset origination, Anemoy (a full-service asset management arm for fund structuring), and Proof-of-Index infrastructure for tokenizing structured financial products like S&P 500 index funds.

Blockchain.com is a comprehensive cryptocurrency service platform offering digital asset wallets, an exchange, a blockchain explorer, and developer APIs. Users can securely store, send, and receive various cryptocurrencies through its wallet, trade spot and derivatives on the exchange, and participate in lending, staking, and other financial services. Its blockchain explorer allows querying on-chain transaction records, and API services facilitate developers in building applications. The platform employs security measures such as cold storage to protect user assets.
